parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, border/document targeting or organised police targeting is documented; same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 2010. A traditional third-gender role is culturally accepted and the 2013 constitution plus 2013 anti-hate-speech/business-discrimination laws expressly include gender identity, a documented positive. Absent legal gender recognition is a resident gap, not deducted for a visitor with home documents, and no visitor document rejection is shown. Offsetting this, majority churches frame trans identity/cross-dressing as sinful to be corrected, social mores are conservative with documented discrimination and bullying, and reporting is discouraged by distrust/harassment concerns with no documented successful trans-visitor remedy. One trans murder in 2018 is a dated single incident with no rate or outcome. Thin recourse against tier-3 societal hostility places this moderately below acceptance-plus-working-protections jurisdictions.
